---
title: Google Analytics
---

Metrics derived from the CanadaLogin GA4 property, in the `google_analytics`
schema. See the [Data Catalog](../catalog/google_analytics.qmd) for the
underlying tables.

Task success rates are computed from GA4 **funnels**: named, ordered sequences
of page or event steps, defined as version-controlled YAML rather than a
private GA4 UI exploration. A funnel's exact steps can change as CanadaLogin's
own pages change, so metrics on this page describe the general calculation and
point to that YAML on GitHub as the definitive, current source, rather than
hard-coding step names that may already be out of date by the time they're
read.
